scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 mixed but playable, 7 good with clear friction, 10 exceptional within assessed scope. Subjective holistic grades, not a win/loss grade or physical-device certification.

reasons.overallMobile: Two complete mission loops with understandable objectives, strong atmosphere and workable assisted touch controls; crowded HUD and reliance on contextual guidance limit confidence in free manual play.
reasons.controls: Native two-contact MOVE and FIRE drag produced visible patrol eliminations in each attempt; scene swipe worked. Tap aim assistance was effective. Short interrupted contacts cannot grade sustained rearming or thumb comfort.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, coil disabling and deck upload gave a clear sequence and visible progress; most traversal was route assisted, limiting assessment of navigation and combat depth. Stationary upload succeeded with remaining shield; this alone does not establish balance or enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Cohesive rainy industrial setting, cyan/amber color language, weapon and result screen gave a consistent atmosphere. Audio and hardware rendering unassessed.
reasons.usability: Large primary touch buttons, changing hold labels, map legend/route length and explicit assist counters were useful. Coil I required repositioning after a generic MAP cue; the map helped once.
reasons.readability: Health, ammo and terminal stats readable; distant patrol silhouettes and small environmental labels were harder at 844x390. Large right-side threat banners consume scene area.

coverage.manualOpeningGuard: Tap aim + MOVE forward + FIRE drag; TARGET DOWN, ammo 30 to 21, health/shield 100/60.
coverage.manualPatrol: Visible left perimeter patrol tapped; simultaneous MOVE diagonal and FIRE drag; SENTINEL DOWN, ammo 21 to 18. No shot miss observed; tap assistance means this is not unaided aim accuracy.
coverage.map: Opened on MAP FIND ENTRY; read 14m walking route; visibly closed.
coverage.custodian: Tapped III then II AIM markers and fired; repositioned using route to I. First I burst exhausted magazine at 37%; next aimed batch during reload finished I. Correction was retapping the newly positioned marker.
coverage.traversal: Mostly HOLD ROUTE/HOLD APPROACH; all memories recovered, held deck through upload.

helpful: Target down and coil OFF feedback
frustrating: Directional threat prompts occupy right scene space
Remaining coil lacked marker until repositioning
failuresAndUncertainties: No loss or failed recovery observed
Magazine emptied on coil I; needed reload and second batch
100% accuracy is the displayed assisted result, not proof of precise drag aiming

attempts.freshStart: Visible START FRESH via #play-again act with capture; reset 100 health / 60 shield / 30+180 ammo and blank recovery markers.

coverage.openingGuard: Tap aim and anchored FIRE; TARGET DOWN, 30 to 21 ammo. No manual move here.
coverage.manualPatrol: Ahead-right patrol near east approach tapped at current view; MOVE diagonal plus FIRE drag; SENTINEL DOWN; 21 to 19 ammo; health/shield remained 100/60 in this batch.
coverage.sceneTurn: No independent scene swipe in second run; target taps and route changed heading. Dedicated swipe covered in attempt one.
coverage.traversal: HOLD ROUTE/APPROACH/RECOVER; three memories recovered. Separate capture at Mara showed partially filled recovery bar, then next hold completed.
coverage.custodian: Tapped current III, II and I AIM markers with FIRE holds; used learned route repositioning to I; all OFF, 2 rounds left. No reload needed.
coverage.deck: Entered via route then stayed stationary for upload; shield fell 47 to 21, result won.

helpful: Context button followed route, approach and recovery states
Coil AIM and OFF feedback helped repeat objective
Upload percentage clarified staying on deck
frustrating: Small moving patrol target required inspection
Offscreen threat direction competes with scene and right controls
Route changes camera direction abruptly relative to manual view
failuresAndUncertainties: No failed shot visibly established; displayed 100% includes assistance
Left other threats alive and took shield damage during routing/recovery
No loss, retry or failed objective observed
No claim that familiarity improved speed: both displayed 00:58; different routes, inputs and pauses prevent causal comparison
